steer.label: Steer
steer.description: Apply the message at the next step of the current response.

queue.label: Append
queue.description: Queue the message for a later turn.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.description: GPT models from OpenAI, including the newest reasoning and multimodal options.

anthropic.label: Anthropic
anthropic.description: Claude models from Anthropic for coding, analysis, and long-context work.

github-copilot.label: GitHub Copilot
github-copilot.description: Use your GitHub Copilot access to sign in and enable supported foundation models.

google.label: Google
google.description: Gemini models from Google for multimodal and large-context tasks.

groq.label: Groq
groq.description: Fast hosted inference for supported open and frontier models.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.description: Route requests across multiple providers and model families from one account.

mistral.label: Mistral
mistral.description: Mistral AI hosted models for general-purpose and coding workloads.

notifications.appSettingsDescription: Review system settings for this app.
notifications.batteryOptimizationDescription: Allow the app to run more reliably in the background.
notifications.enabledFeedback: Notifications are enabled on this device.
notifications.disabledFeedback: Notifications are still disabled. Open system settings to enable them manually.

onDeviceInput.title: On-device voice input
onDeviceInput.description: Prefer local speech recognition and avoid cloud fallback when possible.

autoPlay.title: Auto-play assistant replies
autoPlay.description: Read the latest assistant response aloud when it finishes.

workingSound.title: Working sound
workingSound.description: Play a calm loop while the assistant is still working on a reply.

resumeListening.title: Resume listening after reply
resumeListening.description: In conversation mode, start listening again after spoken playback ends.

speechLocale.label: Speech locale
speechLocale.helper: Leave empty to use the system default language for voice input and playback.

brief.label: Brief
brief.description: Short, tightly scoped answers for natural back-and-forth.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Concise answers with a little more context when helpful.

detailed.label: Detailed
detailed.description: Longer explanations and more supporting detail.

nextActions.title: Simple next actions
nextActions.description: End replies with a short recommendation when there is a clear next move.

soft.label: Soft chime
soft.description: Warm layered tone with a gentle pulse.

voice.footer: Android can periodically check running sessions in the background and post a completion notification. Background speech and continuous microphone capture are not supported.

check.title: Voice check
check.restrictedHint: Speech recognition is restricted on this device. Contact your device administrator.
check.unavailableHint: Turn on Siri & Dictation in your device Settings, then re-check.
check.deniedHint: Access was denied. Open settings to enable it manually.
check.testFailed: Speech playback failed. Check the selected voice and the device volume.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.invalidCommand: Enter the local command as a JSON string array.

language.title: Language
language.description: Use the system language or pick one for the app interface.

appearance.chatTextSizeDescription: Adjust message text size in chat. Smaller text shows more of the conversation at once.

flatThread.title: Flat conversation
flatThread.description: Show messages full-width without bubbles so more of the conversation fits on screen.

slimInterface.title: Slim interface
slimInterface.description: Shrink buttons, spacing, and headers in chat, terminal, and project so more text fits on screen.

basic.label: Basic
basic.description: Show user and assistant messages only.

reasoning.label: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Also show the assistant's reasoning as collapsed rows.

verbose.label: Verbose
verbose.description: Also show tool calls as collapsed rows.

appearance.footer: Everything here applies instantly and is saved on this device.

background.title: Background
background.info: The animated layer behind the whole app: pick a preset or build your own look.

presets.hint: A preset sets the style, all colors and all sliders together. Adjust anything afterwards.

style.info: The kind of animation. Switching style loads that style's defaults with your theme's colors.

colors.title: Colors
colors.info: The base color plus one color per light ball, particle layer or band.
colors.none: Video backgrounds use the video's own colors.

sliders.title: Sliders
sliders.info: Every style has the same sliders; 0 is the style's default, Reset returns there.

saved.info: Save the current background and appearance under a name, and load it later.

icons.info: The icon set used across the app.

color.eyedropperHint: Tap the live background to pick a color from it.

text.title: Text & fonts
text.info: Font, size, color and effects for app and chat text, with a live chat preview.
text.effectsHint: Shadow, outline, glow and emboss need Android 12 or later.
text.previewQuestion: Can you check the settings sheet?

connect.scanHint: Scan your computer’s QR code to connect.
connect.scanLocalHint: Use this if your computer is showing a pairing QR code.
connect.manualHint: Use this to type a server URL, username and password.
connect.scanWhere: Where do I find this? The code is shown on your computer by the pairing script (opencode pair) or the desktop helper.
connect.manualWhere: Where do I find this? The URL, username and password come from your OpenCode server setup.

enable.title: Check for updates
enable.description: Offer new versions when they are available on the store.

available.label: When available
available.description: Surface a new version as soon as the store reports it.

daily.label: Daily
daily.description: Check for a new version at most once a day.

weekly.label: Weekly
weekly.description: Check for a new version at most once a week.

permissions.title: Saved permissions
permissions.description: Rules created by “Always allow”. Removing one makes the server ask again.

descriptions.gradient: A still three-color gradient. Lightest on battery.
descriptions.video: Your own looping video from assets/backgrounds/motion.mp4; falls back to the gradient if none is set.
descriptions.paths: Thin lines sweep across the screen in two mirrored fans (after Kokonut UI Background Paths).
descriptions.liquid: Up to six glowing liquid blobs that merge where they touch.
descriptions.swirl: A dithered pixel spiral with three colored arms turning around the center.
descriptions.cyber: Thousands of tiny particles drifting along a Perlin-noise flow field.
descriptions.mesh: Large blurred color blobs that slowly drift past each other.
descriptions.prism: A kaleidoscope of rounded, morphing cells with iridescent edges.
descriptions.aurora: Two soft light balls drift, collide and blend their colors where they overlap.
descriptions.halftone: Flowing noise clouds drawn as a two-tone pixel halftone.
descriptions.papermesh: Paper Shaders mesh gradient: blended color blobs with distortion, swirl and grain.
descriptions.hive: Rotating glowing hexagon outlines with three color bands on a dark field.
descriptions.gradient3: Three large light balls wander slowly and blend into one smooth gradient.
descriptions.bounce: Glowing balls bounce elastically off the edges and each other, flashing on impact.
descriptions.orbit: Balls pulled by gravity orbit a center well and merge on close passes.
descriptions.repel: Balls push each other away; hard near-misses send out a shockwave ring.
descriptions.waves: Layered glowing sine ribbons that flare where they cross.
descriptions.starfield: Stars rushing toward you in three depth layers.
descriptions.plasma: Classic flowing sine plasma through a three-color palette.

theme.title: Color theme
theme.hint: Applies instantly and suggests matching background colors, which you can still change below.

fonts.textSizeHint: Stacks with your system font size.
